The app closed unexpectedly last time
A crash report was saved. If this keeps happening, you can send the report to the developer.
VaultSync needs to read and write files and folders in phone storage (including the .git folders inside them). Please grant storage permission.
VaultSync needs to read and write files and folders in phone storage (including the .git folders inside them). Please turn on “All files access” for VaultSync in system settings.
Your notes are in the remote repository but not on this phone yet. The repository will be downloaded into an empty folder.
Upload a vault from this phone
There is a folder to sync on this phone (without .git) and the remote is an empty repository. A Git repository will be created in the folder and pushed for the first time.
The vault folder already contains .git (for example, created by another tool). It will be used as is, without changing its history.
Choose or create an empty folder. The repository will be cloned into it.
Choose the existing Git repository folder (it contains .git).
The folder isn\'t empty. Cloning needs an empty folder.
This folder already contains .git. Go back and choose “Use an existing Git repository”.
This folder doesn\'t contain .git. Go back and choose another method.
A folder with this name already exists.
This folder has no .obsidian, so it may not be an Obsidian vault.
Leave empty to use the remote already configured in the repository (origin).
HTTPS address. Authenticates with a personal access token.
SSH address. Authenticates with an SSH key.
Unrecognized address. Supports https://… and SSH addresses; http:// and local paths aren\'t supported.
New token (leave empty to keep the current one)
Create one on GitHub under Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens, with read and write access to this repository\'s contents. The token is stored encrypted on this device.
A token is saved. Only fill this in to replace it.
The saved token can\'t be decrypted (the system keystore changed). Please enter it again.
Connected. The remote is an empty repository.
Enter a valid remote repository URL
The name and email recorded in every commit of this vault. Leave empty to use the defaults from Settings.
No default author is set in Settings, so this must be filled in.
Use the remote already configured in the repository (origin)
Steps: connect to the remote → clone into the selected folder → write the repository settings.
Steps: make sure the remote is empty → create a Git repository → write the recommended .gitignore → commit all files → push.
Steps: open the repository → check the branch and remote → write the repository settings. Existing history is not changed.
The remote is an empty repository. Local content will be pushed on the first sync.
The repository is on branch %1$s (not %2$s as entered), so %1$s will be synced.
The remote URL was changed to %1$s.
This repository has an unfinished merge that still has conflicts. Resolve them in the vault details.
This repository has a merge whose conflicts are resolved but not yet committed. It will be completed on the next sync.
Vaults with SSH addresses authenticate with these keys. Each vault can use a different key; new vaults use the default key. Private keys are stored encrypted on this device and never leave the phone.
No vault uses this key. After deleting it, also remove its public key from the remote (for example, SSH keys on GitHub).

plurals.name: ssh_key_delete_used
plurals.item: %1$d vault uses this key: %2$s. After deleting it, that vault has to choose another key before it can sync. Also remove the public key from the remote.
%1$d vaults use this key: %2$s. After deleting it, these vaults have to choose another key before they can sync. Also remove the public key from the remote.

resources.string: The private key can\'t be decrypted (the system keystore changed). Delete it, then generate or import a key again.
Add the public key below to your remote account, for example on GitHub under Settings → SSH and GPG keys → New SSH key.
Key generated. Add its public key to your remote account.
Generates a new ed25519 key. The name is only shown in this app, to help you tell keys apart.
Paste the whole private key file (from -----BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY----- to -----END … -----). OpenSSH, PEM, PKCS#8 and PuTTY formats are supported.
Unrecognized private key format. Make sure you pasted the private key rather than the public key (.pub), and that the BEGIN / END lines are complete.
This private key is protected by a passphrase. Please enter it.
No SSH keys yet. Generate a new key or import an existing private key.
The key this vault used was deleted. Please choose another one.
Make sure this key\'s public key has been added to your remote account, then test the connection.

The first time you connect to a host, its key is recorded. If the key changes later, the connection is refused to protect against interception. If you\'re sure the server changed its key, “forget” the host and connect again. GitHub\'s keys are built in.
Forget the host key of “%1$s”? It will be recorded again on the next connection.
Unsynced local changes: %1$d modified · %2$d added · %3$d deleted
Other vaults are syncing first. This one will start automatically when its turn comes.
This folder isn\'t a Git repository. It may have been moved, or its .git deleted.
The vault folder can\'t be found. It may have been moved or deleted.
You can clone this vault from its remote again, into the same location: %1$s\nIts remote, branch, token or SSH key and other settings stay as they are.

This phone and the remote changed the same content. Go through the files and choose which version to keep (you can also keep both or edit by hand). When everything is resolved, complete the merge and push.\nYou can also abort this merge: your local commits are not affected, the remote changes stay on the remote, and they will be merged again on the next sync.
Files will go back to your last local commit, and the conflict resolutions you made will be lost. The remote changes are not affected and will be merged again on the next sync.
The merge isn\'t committed yet. Tap “Complete merge and push” to create the merge commit and sync it to the remote.
A previous operation was interrupted and left a lock file (index.lock). It will be removed automatically when you sync.
There is an unfinished merge that still has conflicts.
The conflicts are resolved, but the merge isn\'t committed yet.
The repository is in the middle of an operation this app doesn\'t support (such as a rebase or cherry-pick). Please finish or abort it on your computer first.
The repository has no branch checked out (detached HEAD). Please switch to a branch on your computer first.
The repository has no remote (origin). The URL from the vault settings will be written when you sync.
The branch has no commits yet. It will be pushed on the first sync.
This vault uses an HTTPS address, but no personal access token is saved, so syncing will fail.
The saved token can\'t be decrypted (the system keystore changed). Please enter it again.
The SSH key this vault used was deleted. Choose another key in the vault settings.
The SSH key this vault uses can\'t be decrypted (the system keystore changed). Generate or import a key again, then choose it in the vault settings.
This vault uses an SSH address, but no SSH key is selected.
The remote doesn\'t have this branch yet
The remote rejected the personal access token. Make sure it hasn\'t expired or been revoked and that it has read and write access to this repository\'s contents, then update it in the vault settings.
The remote didn\'t accept this SSH key. Make sure its public key has been added to your remote account (for example, SSH keys on GitHub) and that this key is selected in the vault settings.

Authentication succeeded, but this account or key isn\'t allowed to write (for example, a read-only deploy key, a token without write access, or a protected branch). Please adjust the permissions on the remote.

Check that the repository URL is correct. A private repository also shows up as “not found” when the credentials can\'t access it, so also make sure the token or key belongs to an account that has access.
Server key doesn\'t match the record

The connection was stopped to protect against interception. If you\'re sure the server changed its key (compare it with the fingerprints published by your hosting service), forget the host under “Known hosts” in Settings and try again.
Check your network connection and make sure the remote server is reachable. If you need a proxy to reach it, turn on the proxy on your phone or set up an HTTP proxy in Settings.
The server didn\'t respond for a long time. Check that your network or proxy works, then try again later.

Couldn\'t connect to the HTTP proxy set in Settings, or the proxy refused to forward the connection. Make sure the proxy host and port are correct and that the proxy app is running and accepts connections from this device. If you don\'t need a proxy, turn it off in Settings.
The in-app proxy is on, so also make sure the proxy address works.
Couldn\'t establish a secure connection with the server (certificate check failed). The network may be intercepting the connection, or the device time may be wrong. Please check and try again.

The remote refused to accept this push, usually because of branch protection rules or server-side checks. Your local commits are saved and won\'t be lost. Check the technical details, adjust the settings on the remote, then sync again.
The remote keeps getting new commits
New commits kept appearing on the remote while pushing (your computer may be syncing at the same time). Your local commits are saved; just sync again later.

Files newly added on the remote have the same names as untracked (or .gitignore-ignored) files on this phone. Merging would overwrite them, so the sync stopped. Find the file names in the technical details, rename or move those files, then sync again.
The vault folder may have been moved, renamed or deleted. Check where the folder is; if needed, remove the vault and add it again.
No Git repository in the folder
There is no .git folder in the vault folder; it may have been deleted. Remove the vault and add it again (you can clone it from the remote).
The folder already has a Git repository
This folder already contains .git. Go back and choose “Use an existing Git repository”.
This vault has no usable token saved, or no SSH key selected (or the selected key was deleted). Please add it in the vault settings.
Token or key can\'t be decrypted
The system keystore changed, so the saved token or private key can no longer be decrypted. Enter the token again in the vault settings, or generate or import an SSH key again.

The repository is in the middle of an operation such as a rebase or cherry-pick, has no branch checked out, or has a different branch checked out than the vault settings. Please sort it out on your computer first, then sync.
Commits need a name and email. Set the default author in Settings, or set one for this vault in the vault settings.
Cloning needs an empty folder. Create a new folder; if the folder already has notes, use “Upload a vault from this phone” or “Use an existing Git repository” instead.
The remote already has content, so the vault can\'t be uploaded over it. Clone the remote into an empty folder first, then move the notes from this phone into it and sync.
The remote doesn\'t have this branch
Go back and change the branch name. The technical details list the branches on the remote.
The repository has no remote (origin) configured. Please enter the remote repository URL.
Nothing to commit in the vault
The selected folder has no files (or they are all ignored by .gitignore). Make sure you selected the right vault folder.
Can\'t read or write files on this device
Storage may be full, or file access permission may have been turned off. Check the storage space and permissions, then try again.
The cause couldn\'t be identified. Check the technical details and the sync log. If you need help, you can export the logs in Settings and send them to the developer.
Until the sync finishes, you can\'t save changes, maintain the repository or remove the vault from the list.
Applies to this vault only. Leave the name and email empty to use the defaults from Settings.
Fill in both the name and email, or leave both empty.
Only removes this app\'s record, token and logs. The vault folder and its .git are not deleted.
The vault folder and its .git stay on the phone. You can add it again later with “Use an existing Git repository”.
Packs and compresses scattered data files to reduce the number of files and the space they take, and to speed up later operations. Your notes and history are not changed.
These rules keep device-specific files such as the workspace layout, caches and trash out of sync. Files that are already synced keep being synced.
Append the missing recommended rules to the end of the vault\'s .gitignore? The change will be committed on the next sync.

Both HTTPS and SSH remotes connect through this proxy. Proxy apps on phones usually listen on a port of 127.0.0.1. If the proxy itself doesn\'t respond within 15 seconds, the connection fails.

When following the system, the app uses the first language in the system\'s language list that it supports, and English if none of them is supported.

Notifications show sync progress and results. With them off, syncing still works, but you won\'t see the progress or get alerts about conflicts and failures. In system settings you can manage the three kinds separately: “Sync progress”, “Sync complete” and “Needs attention”.

Export the vault list, settings, SSH keys and known hosts to a file, to restore them on a new phone or after reinstalling. Tokens and private keys are encrypted with a passphrase you choose. The configuration is normally kept in the app\'s private storage and survives app updates.

Packs the sync logs of all vaults and the crash reports into one file, so you can report a problem. The logs don\'t contain tokens, private keys or passphrases.

While syncing, the app shows the progress in the notification bar and runs as a foreground service, so the sync continues when you switch to other apps. If the sync still stops after you switch away, allow VaultSync to run in the background in system settings, or exclude it from battery optimization.
Obsidian vaults are usually in Internal storage/Documents/<vault name>. You can find the exact location in Obsidian under “Manage vaults”.
